cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Act as If It’s True
cards.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your sister's bringing her future self to dinner. Set two places, please; I'll check them before anyone sits down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only saved one chair for her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use mine for the second place. Count guests, not names; we can't leave one of her standing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put the chairs together and use one name card.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two cards. Put 'future' on the second. I won't have you asking the wrong one how dinner turned out.

reason: Keep the actual label correction and replace the distracting meal-refusal rule with the useful distinction between present and future knowledge.
